I will not make big changes this year. On 14 mu, I will keep the main ground in wheat-maize because that is the surest way for me to get grain, and I will leave a smaller piece for cotton because cotton still brings cash if the stand is good. I do what I have seen work around me: wheat and maize get the better land and enough fertilizer so I do not lose yield, because losing harvest hurts more than spending a bit extra on bags of fertilizer. With well water, I will not let wheat dry at jointing and filling, and I will give maize water at the key time after it gets tall and around silking. Cotton I will keep on the smaller piece, feed it a bit heavier on potash than grain, and spray more times because if I do not watch insects and disease, cotton can fail fast. I will use improved or hybrid seed where I have seen neighbors get a better stand and fuller ears, but I will still farm in the old steady way: rotary till where it saves labor, enough base fertilizer, topdress when the crop is asking for it, and do not cut inputs too hard.
